reviews.title: Blinkit refused to replace or return a useless extension board
reviews.text: I recently ordered an extension board from Blinkit for my MacBook charger. When it arrived, I found that the socket design doesn't allow the Apple charger to fit properly, making the extension board completely unusable for me. I contacted Blinkit support immediately, explained the issue, and even shared photos. Instead of offering a replacement or return, they simply kept saying, We can't help with this. No replacement, no refund, no solution.
